ops.body: Current actual public59bb source rechecked during PR645: retiredHoldings still calls retiredWorktree for every candidate before reading its HEAD. That helper opens admin/gitdir and the payload .git, then stats both admin identities; unrelated branches therefore retain this separate namespace cost after645. No host file-byte cause proved. Next independent bounded experiment: same32/1024 arbitrary-retired fixture, trace openat/newfstatat attempts on unrelated payload .git paths. A branch-filtered reader may skip backlink probes only for successfully read nonmatching HEADs; unreadable HEADs still require old backlink classification before deciding whether to expose the existing error. Preserve full Holdings reader and arbitrary retired support. Security-sensitive ordering must be reviewed before code/landing; no TTL/index assumption or canonical-root restriction.645 ships independently first.
